Build the dense inverse of the genomic relationship matrix (G-inverse)

Source: R/build_Ginv.R
build_Ginv.Rd

Computes a dense \(G^{-1}\) for the genotyped animals using a VanRaden method-1 style construction of \(G\), followed by matrix inversion. Optional affine tuning of \(G\) can be applied before inversion.

build_Ginv(
  X,
  maf_threshold = 0.05,
  missing_code = 5L,
  blend = 0.05,
  chunk_size = 2000L,
  n_threads = 1L,
  tunedG = 0L,
  A22 = NULL,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

X

Genotype matrix of dimension n_gen x m, coded as 0/1/2. Missing genotypes must be coded with missing_code.

maf_threshold

Minor allele frequency threshold used to filter SNPs.

missing_code

Integer code representing missing genotypes.

blend

Blending factor applied to \(G\) before optional tuning.

chunk_size

Number of SNP columns processed per chunk.

n_threads

Number of OpenMP threads used by the compiled backend during genomic matrix construction and related parallel steps.

tunedG

Integer tuning option for \(G\): 0 = no tuning; 1 = standardize by matching mean diagonal/off-diagonal contrast within \(G\); 2 = affine tuning to match \(A_{22}\) mean diagonal and off-diagonal; 3 = shift \(G\) by a constant so its global mean matches \(A_{22}\).

A22

Optional dense pedigree-based relationship matrix for the same genotyped animals and in the same order as the rows of X. Required when tunedG is 2 or 3.

verbose

Logical; if TRUE, print progress messages from the compiled genomic matrix construction routine.

Value

A list containing Ginv and several diagnostics describing SNP filtering and tuning.

Details

The matrix X is coerced to an integer matrix before being passed to the compiled backend. When tunedG equals 2 or 3, A22 must be supplied and must have dimensions n_gen x n_gen.

See also

build_Ainv(), build_Hinv()
